# Privacy Notice - KiranaKart

This notice is available in English and in Hindi and the other languages listed in the Eighth Schedule to the Constitution. Choose your language at the top of this page.

KiranaKart ('we') respects your privacy. This notice explains how we handle your personal data when you use KiranaKart.

WHAT PERSONAL DATA WE COLLECT
* Name
* Mobile number
* Delivery address
* Order history
* UPI ID used for payment
* Live location during delivery

WHY WE USE IT
We use this data only to:
1. Take and deliver orders
2. Process payments
3. Let the delivery partner find the address
4. Send order updates by SMS and WhatsApp

YOUR RIGHTS
You can ask for a summary of the personal data we hold about you and how we process it. You can also ask us to correct, complete or update it, or to erase it when it is no longer needed. Send your request through kiranakart.in/privacy-requests. You may nominate someone who can exercise your rights on your behalf in the event of your death or incapacity.

WITHDRAWING YOUR CONSENT
To withdraw consent, use the 'Withdraw consent' button in your account settings or at kiranakart.in/privacy. It is as easy as giving consent was.

COMPLAINTS
If you have a grievance about how we handle your data, use the grievance form at kiranakart.in/grievance. We will respond within 30 days. You may also file a complaint with the Data Protection Board of India, using the digital office on its website.

KEEPING YOUR DATA SAFE
We use reasonable security safeguards and delete your data once it is no longer needed for the purposes above.

CONTACT US
Grievance Officer: Sameer Khan (support-privacy@kiranakart.in)

# Privacy Notice - Pathshala Plus

Welcome to Pathshala Plus. Please read this notice before you agree to let us process your personal data.

## What personal data we collect
1. Student's name
2. Class and school name
3. Parent's mobile number
4. Parent's email address
5. Test scores and progress reports
6. Recordings of live doubt-solving sessions

## Why we use it
We use this data only to:
1. Create the student's account and personalise lessons to their class
2. Send progress reports and class reminders to the parent
3. Record live sessions so the student can rewatch them

## Your rights
You have the right to access a summary of your personal data and our processing of it, and to have it corrected, completed, updated or erased. Make a request under Help > My data. You can also nominate another person to exercise these rights for you if you die or become unable to do so. Add a nominee under Settings > Nominee.

## Withdrawing your consent
You can withdraw your consent at any time under Settings > Privacy > Manage consent. It takes the same few taps as giving consent. Withdrawal does not affect processing done before it.

## Complaints
If you have a grievance about how we handle your data, raise it under Help > Raise a grievance. We will respond within 30 days. If you are not satisfied with our response, you can complain to the Data Protection Board of India through its online portal.

## Children
If you are under 18, we will process your personal data only after we get verifiable consent from your parent or lawful guardian. We do not track or behaviourally monitor children, and we do not show them targeted advertising.

## Keeping your data safe
We protect your data with encryption and access controls, and we keep it only as long as needed for these purposes.

## Contact us
Questions about this notice or your data? Contact our Data Protection Officer, Ritu Sharma, at dpo@pathshalaplus.in.
